summary: Teekay Tankers Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, reporting its first quarter 2026 earnings and routine operational updates. It disclosed GAAP net income of $153.6 million ($4.42 per share), ongoing vessel acquisitions and sales under a fleet renewal plan, and the declaration of a $0.25 quarterly dividend plus a $1.00 special dividend. There is no extraordinary corporate event—the vessel transactions are ordinary-course capital expenditures, not a transformative acquisition or divestiture. This is a standard earnings release, not a special situation. The filing does not trigger any of the defined categories.
